comment: Printing. Section 1 of the v0.2 machine script.

rules.title: Print Spooler starts automatically
rules.summary: The Spooler service is set to automatic startup (registry and Set-Service); PrintNotify stays manual.
rules.effect: Printing works right after installation: USB and network printers, "Print to PDF". The service starts with Windows even if it was set to manual start before.
rules.risk: Print Spooler has historically been a source of vulnerabilities (PrintNightmare); this is mitigated by the rule that restricts driver installation to administrators and by the firewall.
rules.versions: No changes across versions. 24H2 has Windows Protected Print mode (WPP); it is not enabled because older printers require their own drivers.

actions.script: try { Set-Service -Name Spooler -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Log 'Spooler startup type = Automatic' 'OK' } catch { Write-Log "Set-Service Spooler: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'WARN' }

rules.title: Only administrators can install printer drivers
rules.summary: Point and Print policy: installing and updating printer drivers requires administrator rights and shows a warning.
rules.effect: A standard user cannot install a printer driver; drivers that are already installed and class drivers are available to everyone.
rules.risk: An administrator must connect a network printer that needs a new driver. While Admin has a blank password, the credential prompt in a user session will not succeed.
rules.versions: Windows default since August 2021 (KB5005652); the rule enforces it through policy.
